title: Thermodynamics of Deformed AdS-Schwarzschild Black Holes Beyond the Bekenstein Paradigm
summary: This work investigates the thermodynamic behavior of deformed AdS-Schwarzschild black holes by incorporating higher-order corrections within non-interacting spacetime models and extended entropy frameworks. To address the inadequacies of classical statistical mechanics in describing gravitational systems with non-local and long-range interactions, we employ non-extensive entropy formalisms, specifically Tsallis and Barrow entropies, which capture quantum-scale deviations and extended correlations.
